glossary.definition: (1) "Law enforcement officer" has the same meaning as in section 2901.01 of the Revised Code and in Criminal Rule 2.
glossary.source_title: Section 2933.231 - Waiving the statutory precondition for nonconsensual entry.

glossary.definition: (2) "Prosecutor" has the same meaning as in section 2935.01 of the Revised Code, and includes any prosecuting attorney as defined in Criminal Rule 2.
